physics: Original Natural A95; SamePhysicalWallDisplacedAcceptedV1; DisplacedNeutralCompositeV1; floor0,H=7.5mm,d=3.5mm; fixed physical-height ids012 mean fit and normalization; actual endpoint K, transported nonconstant inner k, dependent epsilon; finite inner nu, zero outer molecular diffusion; full signed production/covariance; full-height inlet, RN top, absolute nonlinear outlet traction

governing.method: IMEX1 single sweep,cacheOff; unchanged mass,source,history and trace treatment
governing.forbidden: physics/input retuning,clipping,floors,restoration,cancellation,pressure reset/regauging,post-k repair,extra governing sweeps,new spaces or backend expansion

diagnostic.scope: actual strip, both momentum components; read-only native row generation and independently checked continuous/represented stress loads
diagnostic.storage: fixed small collection of global momentum component/region vectors; sparse local row support per generating element, never element-count times global-size dense arrays; original dense-export guard retained
diagnostic.reference: analytical composite values/gradients on identical native integration/test rows; no polynomial surrogate; independent oracle verifies tensors, finite-nu resistance and native load reconstruction
diagnostic.interface: common velocity test rows receive both volume sides once; outward one-sided interface fluxes are separate diagnostics, not extra governing loads
diagnostic.rows: retain all raw momentum rows, actual free velocity IDs and prescribed reactions; apply constraint replacement separately
diagnostic.pressure_image: -W^-1 D M^-1 r_j with complete actual G,D,consistent free M,C=0 and unused gauge excluded; signed component and band sums and cross-products retained
diagnostic.solves: independent sparse direct consistent mass and matrix-free pressure diagnostic solves with true residual checks; tighter repeat and signed-sum uncertainty check; no diagnostic solve enters a history
diagnostic.row_scale: max(1,maximum original load or contribution magnitude); absolute primitive also reported
diagnostic.quadrature: native governing policy plus held-coefficient 48/64 controls; pressure observation norm separate; no observation-gauge subtraction

selection.space: P4/P2, unchanged x partition,roof,interface,continuous functions and projection
selection.signal: band signed alignment a_j=<deltaPi_j,deltaPi_total>_physical_mass/||deltaPi_total||^2 from represented-minus-continuous loads, not isolated unsigned stress norms
selection.rule: find the smallest contiguous set of existing radial slabs containing at least80 percent of sum|a_j| (ties lowest height); if it occupies at most ceil(number_of_slabs/3), bisect that band; otherwise uniformly bisect all radial slabs once
selection.checks: signed band sum, cancellation and native/continuous row reconstruction must pass before selection; freeze exact nodes, native count, physical input and static state before histories

histories.baseline: reuse sealed CT9 sparse .001 only after exact full-identity verification; add fresh sparse .0005 toT=.008 and compare with sealed dense .0005 under1e-8 scaled equivalence
histories.initialization: fresh same-space identical actual coefficient vectors and independent dt histories; cross-space continuous input identical, projections separate
histories.continuation: only a complete passing unambiguous candidate pair may continue unchanged dt/method toT=.02, drift always from actual time-zero state
histories.stop: first genuine physical/accuracy rejection retained; no additional mesh or timestep search

acceptance.pressure: absolute Pi; both global and regional diagnostics
acceptance.domains: all mandatory scalar,covariance,A95 radicand,cutoff and finite-state inventories unchanged; no new predictor-domain rejection
acceptance.report: also delta divided by absolute preservation tolerance; this does not replace the frozen relative rule

comparison: common physical integration grid resolving both meshes and active analytical breaks; explicit interface sides; value/gradient projection error, drift, absolute reference error, temporal and spatial differences distinct; no convergence-order inference from two spaces

target.prerequisites: passing complete strip contract, target-specific reference/load/traction/quadrature/domain preflights, justified dt pair and finite measured accepted-step resource plan
target.segments: at most64 steps per genuine same-method segment
target.resource_stage: declare finite CPU/wall,storage,checkpoint and step ceilings in a prospective target-admission receipt before launch
target.mesh: any target amendment must retain matched flat/terrain definition and receive new native count/nnz/fill/memory receipts

historical: CT8/CT9 pressure failures,eight extraction failures,observation roles and curved temporal/spatial failures immutable; A95 does not admit other models or terrain
